findings.subject: INT11 report fixture uses actual native source and economic replay
evidence: tests/e0_report_fixtures.py:99-109 builds NativeCoverageReceipt, VenuePath and E0NativeExecutionSource from the same retained canonical events
tests/e0_report_fixtures.py:141-164 creates the matching FillScenario and E0ExecutionEvidence for every retained bracket
tests/e0_report_fixtures.py:165-172 binds manifest source/coverage/fee versions and passes actual path/scenario with finalize_day=False
reporting.py:320-399 replays the native source and checks path values, fills, source quotes and account/order joins
findings.result: The reviewed INT11 F03 account fixture does not use a favorable fill override, a quote-only path, or an omitted native source proof.

findings.subject: restore hardcodes the current route vocabulary
findings.detail: Checkpoint restore reconstructs FillScenario with venue_first and strict_trade_through instead of persisting or deriving same_time_ordering and passive_rule from the registered scenario. All current SCENARIOS use these two values, so no current INT10 mismatch is visible; adding a registered order_first, ambiguous or passive-route scenario would make restore incompatible unless the scenario route is retained in the manifest/checkpoint.
findings.required_follow_up: Either persist these FillScenario route fields in the scenario manifest/checkpoint or explicitly freeze the current route vocabulary as an invariant checked by validate_run_inputs.

findings.subject: E0NativeExecutionSource constructor defers receipt/path binding
findings.detail: E0NativeExecutionSource.__post_init__ type-checks canonical events, selected admission, latency, tick size and recovery tuple, but does not type-check coverage or call venue_path_from_mbp. E0ExecutionEvidence.__post_init__ therefore can be constructed before native coverage/path equivalence is proven; validate_replay and reporting._economic_join later call rebuild/_compare_replay and gate the quality report. This is not an INT11 F03 caller failure because the fixture supplies a NativeCoverageReceipt and _economic_join replays it, but direct consumers should call validate_replay before treating the evidence object as verified.
findings.required_follow_up: If construction-time proof is required, require NativeCoverageReceipt in E0NativeExecutionSource and rebuild/compare the supplied path during E0ExecutionEvidence.__post_init__; otherwise retain the current explicit validate_replay contract.

case_coverage.metadata_note: The previously generated complete-case map retained all 37 frozen case IDs; this review found no new public test method or mapping change.

conclusion: Static review found no current incompatible INT08/INT10/INT11 caller. Two residual integration assumptions are recorded: restore's current route vocabulary and deferred native-source binding at evidence construction. No dynamic pass claim is made.
